name: LOAD_BALANCE_SHEET_TASK
definition:
COPY INTO FINSIGHT_DB.RAW.RAW_BALANCE_SHEET (ticker, report_date, fiscal_quarter, sector, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, common_stock, retained_earnings, data_quality_flag)
FROM (
  SELECT 
    $1:ticker::varchar, 
    $1:date::date,  
    $1:fiscal_quarter::varchar,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(METADATA$FILENAME, 'sector=', 2), '/', 1)::varchar AS sector, 
    $1:total_assets::double, 
    $1:total_liabilities_net_minority_interest::double, 
    -- We map the long yfinance name to our clean column
    $1:total_equity_gross_minority_interest::double, 
    $1:common_stock::double, 
    $1:retained_earnings::double, 
    $1:data_quality_flag::varchar
  FROM @balance_sheet_stage
)
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'PARQUET')
PATTERN = '.*.parquet'
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE'
force = True

name: LOAD_CASH_FLOW_TASK
definition:
COPY INTO FINSIGHT_DB.RAW.RAW_CASH_FLOW
  (ticker, report_date, fiscal_quarter, sector, net_income, depreciation_amortization, stock_based_compensation, change_in_working_capital, data_quality_flag)
FROM (
  SELECT
    $1:ticker::varchar,
    $1:date::date,
    $1:fiscal_quarter::varchar,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(METADATA$FILENAME, 'sector=', 2), '/', 1)::varchar AS sector,
    $1:net_income::double,
    $1:depreciation_and_amortization::double,
    $1:stock_based_compensation::double,
    $1:change_in_working_capital::double,
    $1:data_quality_flag::varchar
  FROM @cash_flow_stage
)
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'PARQUET')
PATTERN = '.*\.parquet'
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE'

name: LOAD_COMPANY_PROFILE_TASK
definition:
COPY INTO FINSIGHT_DB.RAW.RAW_COMPANY_PROFILE (ticker, company_name, sector, industry, exchange, country, employees)
FROM (
  SELECT $1:ticker::varchar, $1:shortName::varchar, $1:sector::varchar, $1:industry::varchar, $1:exchange::varchar, $1:country::varchar, $1:fullTimeEmployees::int
  FROM @company_profile_stage
)
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'PARQUET')
PATTERN = '.*.parquet'
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE'

name: LOAD_INCOME_STATEMENT_TASK
definition:
COPY INTO FINSIGHT_DB.RAW.RAW_INCOME_statement
  (ticker, report_date, fiscal_quarter, sector, ebitda, total_revenue, operating_income, gross_profit, total_debt, cash_and_equivalents, operating_cash_flow, capital_expenditure, data_quality_flag)
    FROM (
  SELECT
    $1:ticker::varchar,
    $1:date::date,
    $1:fiscal_quarter::varchar,
    SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(METADATA$FILENAME, 'sector=', 2), '/', 1)::varchar AS sector,
    $1:ebitda::double,
    $1:total_revenue::double,
    $1:operating_income::double,
    $1:gross_profit::double,
    $1:total_debt::double,
    $1:cash_and_cash_equivalents::double,
    $1:operating_cash_flow::double,
    $1:capital_expenditure::double,
    $1:data_quality_flag::varchar
  FROM @income_statement_stage
)
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'PARQUET')
PATTERN = '.*\.parquet'
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE'

name: LOAD_MARKET_DATA_TASK
definition:
COPY INTO FINSIGHT_DB.RAW.RAW_MARKET_DATA (ticker, price_date, closing_price, volume, market_cap)
FROM (
  SELECT 
    $1:ticker::varchar, 
    $1:date::date, 
    $1:close::double, 
    $1:volume::bigint, 
    -- DEFENSIVE FIX: Check both common variants of the key
    COALESCE($1:marketcap::double, $1:market_cap::double) 
  FROM @market_data_stage
)
FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'PARQUET')
-- PATTERN FIX: Ignore the .crc files and only load the 'part' data files
PATTERN = '.*.parquet' 
ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE'
